subject: Trial bridge + performance-tied grant for Avery Labs
messages:
From: Devon Park <devon@averylabs.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro: trial bridge ask + performance-tied grant

Hey Lukas / Marissa / Ben,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency and cost numbers looked promising for our internal sandbox. We’re launching a 10-team accelerator cohort in June and would like to pilot Redwood for the sandbox environment. A couple of asks from procurement + ops: 

- Can Redwood extend a trial bridge that combines free credits with a performance-tied grant (credits unlocked as we hit usage milestones)?
- We’d prefer a quick vesting schedule (30–45 days) — we need to show usage to sponsors during demo week.
- Any ability to include a revenue-share option in lieu of a larger upfront discount? Long-term we’d consider a revenue share for a portion of incremental paid usage.

I attached a quick usage forecast (avery_usage_forecast.xlsx) to help size things. Our procurement prefers DocuSign-enabled agreements. Can you share an outline we can send to legal?

Thanks,
Devon Park
Head of Ops, Avery Labs
devon@averylabs.com

--
Attachment: avery_usage_forecast.xlsx (Excel spreadsheet, 32KB)

From: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Park <devon@averylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: trial bridge ask + performance-tied grant

Hi Devon — great to hear the demo landed well. Appreciate the forecast, that helps a lot.

High level proposal we can start with (internal outline):
- 60-day sandbox bridge with $12,000 platform credits applied to usage (tokens + embeddings).
- Credits vest 40% immediately, remaining 60% unlocked in two milestone tranches tied to aggregate token consumption and active cohort count. Target vesting window: 45 days.
- Optional performance-tied revenue share: 12% of incremental topline from production usage for first 6 months, with a 6-month cap. This would be a fallback if Avery prefers lower upfront pricing.
- DocuSign-ready commercial summary + SOW for procurement.

I’ve attached a quick draft mutual action plan (draft-MAP.md) with timeline and kickoff actions — nothing legal, just an ops-level plan we can iterate. Lauren, Ben — can you confirm feasibility on billing and revenue-share mechanics?

Next steps: if Devon is comfortable with this outline, we’ll produce a short commercial one-pager and a DocuSign-friendly proposal to send to Avery legal.

Thanks,
Lukas Meyer
Head of Partnerships (INTERIM)
Redwood Inference
lukas_meyer@redwood.ai

--
Attachment: draft-MAP.md (text, 5KB)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Devon Park <devon@averylabs.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 08:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: trial bridge ask + performance-tied grant

Thanks — quick thoughts from sales ops:

- We can do a $12k credit plus the milestone vesting as Lukas suggested, but procurement often pushes back on rev-share because of revenue recognition and tracking. If Avery is open to simpler economics, we can offer a promotional price (20% off list for first 6 months) on dedicated capacity instead of rev-share.
- Alternative offer: $15k starter grant, 3-month ramp period, and a 10% promo rate for any Dedicated capacity purchases in the first 6 months. That reduces legal complexity.

Lauren — can you confirm whether billing system supports offsetting credits against invoices (consuming credits first then invoicing)? If not, we need to do an upfront invoice split.

Devon — which approach do you prefer: revenue-share (more flexible) or upfront promo + credit pool (simpler)?

Ben
Senior GTM, Redwood Inference

--
(Inline reply to Lukas' outline)

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Devon Park <devon@averylabs.com>
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: trial bridge ask + performance-tied grant

Hi all — billing/finance notes:

- Our billing stack can apply credits as an offset against usage invoices; credits are consumed first, then an invoice is generated if there’s overage. That supports the $12–15k credit model with vesting.
- Revenue-share is possible contractually but requires legal + finance review for revenue recognition. If Avery wants rev-share, we’ll need a simple measurable metric (e.g., incremental billed usage vs baseline) and a short term cap. That adds ~7–10 business days to signoff.
- Practical procurement path: PO + 50% upfront invoice, 50% on go-live, credits applied against invoices monthly. If procurement demands no upfront, we can split credits across two invoices (e.g., 50% credit applied month 1, 50% month 2) as a compromise.

I’ve attached a billing schedule template that shows the two common flows. If Avery can send a PO by May 20 we can lock a June 1 start.

Regards,
Lauren Bishop
Director, Finance Ops, Redwood Inference

--
Attachment: billing-schedule-template.xlsx (Excel, 18KB)

From: Devon Park <devon@averylabs.com>
To: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: trial bridge ask + performance-tied grant

Thanks team — appreciate the options. A few clarifications from Avery ops/procurement: 

- Revenue-share is acceptable if it’s limited in scope (12% on incremental revenue up to a $30k cap) and the metric is simple (billed usage above baseline three months post-start). We understand the legal review timeline; that’s OK if we can at least get an operations-level agreement in place for demo week.
- If rev-share complicates things, we prefer the $15k starter grant + 3-month ramp (Ben’s alternative). That’s the fallback.
- PO timeline: we can get a PO issued the week of 5/17 if we have a short commercial summary and a DocuSign link.

Attached is a small runbook with dates for demo week (Skylab_runbook.pdf). We’d like credits front-loaded enough to support demos on 6/2.

Devon Park
Head of Ops, Avery Labs

--
Attachment: Skylab_runbook.pdf (PDF, 74KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Park <devon@averylabs.com>
Cc: Lukas Meyer <lukas_meyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Intro: trial bridge ask + performance-tied grant

Devon — thanks, this is actionable. Quick summary and next steps so everyone has clarity: 

1) Commercial outline we’ll send today (one-pager + DocuSign):
   - Primary path: $12k credit pool, 45-day vesting (40% up front, two milestone tranches) + optional rev-share (12% on incremental billed usage up to $30k cap).
   - Fallback: $15k starter grant with 3-month ramp + 20% promo price on Dedicated for first 6 months.
2) Procurement flow: PO by week of 5/17 -> 50% upfront invoice / 50% on go-live OR split-credit invoice flow per Lauren’s template.
3) Ops: we’ll front-load the first tranche to support your demo on 6/2.
4) Legal: we’ll produce a short rev-share term sheet if you elect that option; otherwise we’ll move with the starter grant doc. Expect DocuSign link within 24 hours.

Action owners: Lukas — finalize one-pager; Ben — coordinate pricing approval with your team; Lauren — prepare invoice template; Marissa — I’ll own DocuSign and kickoff once PO received.

Link: DocuSign proposal (Skylab_DocuSign_Proposal.pdf) — sending shortly.

Looking forward to getting this live.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Program Lead, Partnerships
Redwood Inference
